entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The counsel raises various contentions with regard to the qualification of the Officer who has analyzed the sample as also non-adherence to the relevant provisions under Food Safety and Standards Act 2006 relating to non accreditation of the concerned Laboratory.
Other legal contentions are also raised by the learned senior counsel to justify quashing.
3. The challenge here is to the rejection of the quashment petition by the High Court with the observation that the contentions raised by the petitioners are to be appreciated in course of Trial.
The High Courts view appears to be in order.
The Special Leave Petition is accordingly dismissed.
4. This dismissal order will not prejudice the petitioners from raising all legal questions in future legal process.
5. Pending application(s), if any, stand closed.

[DEEPAK JOSHI] [KAMLESH RAWAT]
